episodes.name: Stop the Bleeding
episodes.overview: After being shot, Gibbs fights for his life aboard a Navy hospital ship, while DiNozzo and Joanna travel to Shanghai to try and take down the Calling.

episodes.name: Personal Day
episodes.overview: Gibbs calls on the team to assist DEA Agent Luis Mitchell with a case that keeps going cold, but DiNozzo discovers there is more to Gibbs’ personal connection to the agent and his desire to help him succeed.

episodes.name: Incognito
episodes.overview: After a Marine is found murdered in Quantico hours after calling Gibbs to discuss a possible case, Bishop and McGee go undercover as a married couple to run surveillance on a Marine Lieutenant and his wife.

episodes.name: Double Trouble
episodes.overview: Vance partners with Gibbs and returns to field duty when a murder case is connected to a former NCIS agent he locked up for stealing evidence.

episodes.name: Lockdown
episodes.overview: While visiting a pharmaceutical lab on a murder case, Abby is trapped with no communication to the outside world after armed men take over the building and hold everyone hostage.

episodes.name: Viral
episodes.overview: When a Petty Officer’s murder matches the M.O. of a local serial killer, the NCIS team must determine if this is the killer’s latest victim or the work of a copycat.

episodes.name: 16 Years
episodes.overview: The NCIS murder case of a retired Navy Lieutenant Commander forces Ducky to reveal his participation in a secret society that solves cold cases.

episodes.name: Saviors
episodes.overview: DiNozzo is reunited with his ex-girlfriend, Jeanne Benoit, when insurgents in Sudan attack a group of volunteer doctors, including her husband.

episodes.name: Day in Court
episodes.overview: In order to clear his name, a Petty Officer volunteers to be court-martialed if NCIS agrees to conduct its own investigation after his murder case is dismissed due to a mishandled warrant.

episodes.name: Blood Brothers
episodes.overview: The Secretary of Defense calls on NCIS to help a sailor who is battling leukemia to locate a donor for a bone marrow transplant, after two of his siblings are killed in the line of duty.

episodes.name: Spinning Wheel
episodes.overview: After Ducky is attacked by a man claiming to have information about his half-brother who died decades ago, the NCIS team searches for the perpetrator.

episodes.name: Sister City (I)
episodes.overview:
The passengers and crew of a private plane traveling from New Orleans to Washington, D.C., are poisoned and the evidence points to Abby's brother, the aircraft's missing chef.

The episode continues on NCIS: New Orleans S2E12 Sister City (II).

episodes.name: Déjà Vu
episodes.overview: While investigating the murder of a seaman who was set to testify before a grand jury, the NCIS team uncovers the resurgence of an international human-trafficking ring.

episodes.name: Decompressed
episodes.overview: Four deep sea divers stay inside a diving chamber with a deceased body in order to decompress. The dead body belongs to a retired Petty Officer who died in mysterious circumstances.

episodes.name: React
episodes.overview: When Secretary of the Navy Sarah Porter learns her daughter has been kidnapped, the NCIS team partners with the FBI to track the case, determine a motive and bring her home.

episodes.name: Loose Cannons
episodes.overview: Doctor Cyril Taft experiences the rush of an NCIS case after he is assigned surgical duty to Gibbs’ suspect and finds key evidence.

episodes.name: After Hours
episodes.overview: The NCIS agents’ personal plans are interrupted when each of them catches errors in a seemingly cut-and-dried case.

episodes.name: Scope
episodes.overview: The NCIS team re-examines an ambush on a group of Special Ops snipers in Iraq after an American couple is attacked in the same area six months later.

episodes.name: Reasonable Doubts
episodes.overview: A Navy Public Affairs officer is murdered, and the victim's wife and mistress accuse each other of the crime.

episodes.name: Charade
episodes.overview: Tony's identity is stolen by multiple perpetrators who go on to blackmail politicians.

episodes.name: Return to Sender
episodes.overview: Gibbs and Senior FBI Agent T.C. Fornell unite after two British prisoners, including a former spy, escape and arrive stateside via a shipping container.

episodes.name: Homefront
episodes.overview: When a 14-year-old foils a home invasion, Gibbs suspects the teenager is withholding pertinent details.

episodes.name: Dead Letter
episodes.overview: The NCIS team, alongside the FBI and MI6, continue an international manhunt for an escaped British spy who has left one colleague fighting for their life in ICU.

episodes.name: Family First
episodes.overview: NCIS, the FBI, and MI6 continue an international manhunt for an escaped British spy who is targeting current and former agents.
